messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: HIGH_SEVERITY: GPU serving queue growth in us-west2. >90% of requests for gptx-small hitting queued state for >15s. Autoscaler attempted 3x scale, failures reported. P95 latency spiking. Paging oncall Amber. https://dash.redwood/example/alerts/1719443210 :rotating_light:

Amber (oncall): I’m on it. Pulling traces and autoscaler logs now. Samir, can you stand by for handoff if this escalates?

Amber (oncall): quick check — queue length by pool:
```
us-west2-spot-a: queue=720 (target 100)
us-west2-spot-b: queue=610 (target 80)
us-west2-dedicated: queue=40 (target 120)
```

Amber (oncall): autoscaler shows repeated scale attempts with error: "failed to allocate instances: quotaExceeded OR noPreemptibleAvail". See logs: `autoscaler/2024-06-27-15:00.log`

Samir (sre): seeing the same. GCP preemptible pool returning 503 on instance create. Also rate-limited by compute API for this project. Looks like spot supply tightness in us-west2 right now.

Devin (infra): confirming — we hit a soft limit on project vCPU requests for preemptible. Also some internal rate throttling from our multi-region allocator.

Amber (oncall): Customer impact: several production customers hitting timeouts for realtime endpoints (text-generate). Error rate up ~7% over baseline. Priya, please warm CS.

Priya (cs): on it. Notifying top 5 customers (IDs: cust-112, cust-204, cust-987) and opening a post on status.redwood. Will mention degraded generation latency and ongoing mitigation.

Amber (oncall): Mitigation plan (attempting in-order):
1) Reduce per-request concurrency for affected routes to lower queue pressure. (rolling config)
2) Temporarily route a subset of traffic to us-east1 dedicated pools that have spare capacity.
3) Trigger manual on-demand instance allocation for critical queues if quota allows.
4) If insufficient, enable fallback to smaller model variant with graceful quality degradation for eligible customers.

Amber (oncall): Executing step 1 now:
`/run infra update-route-concurrency --region=us-west2 --routes=realtime-* --concurrency=1`

deploy-bot: deploy started by Amber (oncall) for route config change. Build 2024.06.27-amber-quiet.

Samir (sre): Trying step 2 — adding routing rule: route 20% of traffic to us-east1-dedicated. Command:
```
routingctl create-split --from=us-west2 --to=us-east1 --pct=20 --selector=realtime
```

Samir (sre): That accepted, split applied. Observing queue delta.

Devin (infra): Attempting manual allocation: sending quota increase request to cloud provider and creating on-demand instances via `allocctl create --count=8 --type=n2-highgpu` — hit an API rate limit on first 3 attempts, retrying with backoff.

Amber (oncall): Quick customer-oriented mitigation: enabling model fallback for non-enterprise customers to gptx-micro. Command:
`/run ml-fallback enable --model=gptx-micro --routes=realtime-nonenterprise`

Priya (cs): Push complete. Messaging customers that we may serve reduced-quality models for a short window to maintain availability.

Amber (oncall): Monitoring metrics: after concurrency throttle + 20% east split, queue for us-west2-spot-a dropped from 720 -> 420 in 6m. P95 latency down ~30%. But still high.

Samir (sre): Autoscaler logs show repeated error: "insufficientPreemptibleCapacity: requested 32 GPUs, available 8". Fallback auto-provision logic tried to allocate smaller instances but failed due to vCPU quota.

Devin (infra): I can free up some vCPU quota by pausing a non-critical batch pool (batch-west2). Pausing now: `infractl pool pause batch-west2-nightly`

Devin (infra): batch-west2 paused, freeing ~64 vCPU. Retrying on-demand allocation.

Devin (infra): On-demand allocation succeeded for 6 instances. Starting provisioning to us-west2-dedicated fallback pool.

Amber (oncall): Great. Marking as partial mitigation. Redirecting another 15% traffic to dedicated fallback.

Samir (sre): Note for postmortem: autoscaler lacks graceful degradation when preemptible pool returns partial capacity — it keeps trying for large batches and hits quota+rate limits. We should implement incremental scale attempts and backoff + smaller instance shapes.

Amber (oncall): Agreed. Also need better fallback routing earlier in pipeline instead of waiting for scale to fully fail.

Priya (cs): Customer update posted to status.redwood: "Degraded generation performance in us-west2. Partial mitigation in place; routing to alternative capacity and smaller models for some customers. Engineers continue to restore full capacity."

Amber (oncall): Handoff to Samir for longer-running work and postmortem. Summary for Samir: initial cause = spot/preemptible shortages in us-west2 + project vCPU quota exhaustion + autoscaler aggressiveness -> queue growth and throttle of requests. Actions taken: concurrency reduction, 35% traffic split to spare region/dedicated, manual on-demand allocation, paused noncritical batch to free quota, enabled model fallback, informed customers.

Samir (sre): Taking over. Will keep running mitigation and assemble timeline. Next steps: run an after-action meeting, propose autoscaler changes (incremental scaling, smaller-shape fallback), and add runbook steps for rapid quota reshuffle.

Amber (oncall): Thanks. Closing paging alert for now; keep thread active for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: route config update by Amber (oncall) (build 2024.06.27-amber-quiet)

Samir (sre): ETA for postmortem doc: EOD today. Will include customer impact summary and recommended infra fixes.

Priya (cs): I'll coordinate follow-up comms with impacted customers after postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Sev2 -> monitoring. Incident assigned to Samir. Tags: gpu-capacity, autoscaler, spot-supply, customer-impact
